description: This file is a makefile defining build rules and device configurations for Chromium OS on specific hardware platforms, including the ASUS OnHub and TP-Link OnHub devices. It contains build definitions, device-specific settings, and references to external scripts and tools.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Defines the build process for creating a GPT partition image, copying the image, and generating a partition table.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Appends the kernel image to the build output using dd with specific block size.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Generates a verified boot (vboot) image using cros-vbutil tool, replacing UUID placeholder '%U' with the actual partition UUID.

methods.name: Device/OnhubImage
methods.description: Defines the device-specific parameters, image types, packages, and build steps for the OnHub devices.

methods.name: Device/asus_onhub
methods.description: Configures ASUS-specific device parameters based on the generic OnHub image setup.

methods.name: Device/tplink_onhub
methods.description: Configures TP-Link-specific device parameters based on the generic OnHub image setup.
